value.rationale: A sharp parametric risk envelope for the standard stochastic facility rule is a natural analysis target when tail-sensitive welfare matters; it exactly settles every positive cost moment, identifies the p=2 robustness threshold, proves blow-up for every p>2, and gives realizable risk-extremal profiles. This goes substantively beyond a small constant correction to the previously known p=1 mean guarantee.
